name: Open-AutoGLM Phone Agent
description: Zhipu's open phone agent that reads the screen with a vision-language model and operates Android or HarmonyOS devices over ADB/HDC.
whatItDoes: Users state a task in natural language, such as opening an app and searching for something, and the agent taps and types through it on a connected phone.
howItWorks: A Python loop captures the screen, queries the AutoGLM-Phone model through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (Zhipu BigModel, ModelScope or self-hosted), and performs the returned action via ADB or HDC, with confirmation for sensitive steps.

requirements.name: Android device with USB debugging
requirements.description: Target phone or emulator; HarmonyOS via HDC also supported

requirements.name: Model API key
requirements.description: BigModel or ModelScope key passed with --apikey, unless self-hosting

run: python main.py --base-url https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4 --model "autoglm-phone" --apikey "your-bigmodel-api-key" "打开美团搜索附近的火锅店"
